source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Once per battle per Drakolithe token, whenever an enemy unit finishes a move up to 8" from this unit, provided the enemy unit finished the move **engaged** with it, or this unit is **[unengaged](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)**, you can roll a D6: on a 3+, the enemy unit takes a [mortal wound](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds).

Keep a Drakolithe token beside this unit per Drakolithe it carries, and take one away whenever this ability is used.

engagementGate: moving enemy ended engaged with owning unit
detail.marker: 1 Drakolithe token beside the unit per Drakolithe carried; remove 1 per use
